mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.5% signals tight labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential investment (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and confidence, which supports corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 indicates weakening real economic activity, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5d returns in more than 60% of cases when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signal a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, suppressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 290.0 and FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates negative 60d returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 152,000 thousand persons, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals labor market overheating that fuels wage inflation and prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS > 152000.0 and UNRATE < 3.7%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) at a quarterly rate above 2.0% signals strong underlying economic momentum that supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of other macro conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% quarterly, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
